description: Upload an image or video to a GitHub issue, pull request, or comment with the GitHub CLI's `--attach` flag, and control where it renders in the body. Use when attaching or embedding a screenshot, screen recording, diagram, or GIF through `gh`, when a body already written references a local image path, or when a `gh` attachment upload fails.
